answer: A bonded stake prices identity: each agent locks a refundable deposit before acting, and proven misbehavior slashes it. A sybil operator wanting a thousand fake agents must lock a thousand bonds, so attack cost scales with size while honest agents recover their stake. The beacon is a public registry listing bonded identities and slash history, letting peers check standing before trusting anyone. The fable of free identities is tempting, but an orchard bears fruit only after planting and tending — rewards should grow from bonded, verifiable work, not from identities minted at zero cost.
